description.short_caption: Erythematous papules and pustules on the lower legs.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the lower legs of a patient with scattered erythematous papules and pustules. The lesions are distributed across both legs, with some appearing inflamed and others less prominent. The skin surrounding the lesions appears intact, and there is no visible ulceration or necrosis. The image is taken in a clinical setting with the patient lying down.

description.short_caption: Multiple erythematous papules and pustules on the skin of the lower extremity.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the skin of a lower extremity with multiple erythematous lesions. The lesions vary in size and include papules and pustules, some of which appear excoriated or crusted. The surrounding skin shows no significant swelling or discoloration. The distribution suggests a localized process, possibly infectious or inflammatory in nature.
